source:
@@U03175@@
Why waste time, why linger long By mingling there with what's unsightly? Here we 塞壬们 come, so sprightly, Singing our melodious song As is right for a 塞壬 throng!

@@U03177@@
(Mocking them in the same melody.)

@@U03178@@
Hurry, force them to the ground, For hidden in those leaves are found Talons long, hooked, and hideous, Which will fall on you perfidious, Should you lend ears to their sound.

@@U03180@@
Away with hate, away with envy! In the purest chalice pour we All the brightest joys there be. Best of water, best of earth, Shapes of beauty, shapes of mirth, Shall be one to welcome thee.

@@U03182@@
What am I hearing? The latest fashion? Ah, neat novelties, to be sure! Voice and string combine to sing, all intertwining in their rhyming, one about the other. It’s lost on me, this warbling. It tickles my ear, but fails to move my heart.

@@U03184@@
Ha! Your heart! Don't flatter yourselft A shriveled leather pouch is more like it, to judge by your face.
translation:
@@U03175@@
为什么要浪费时间，为什么要长时间徘徊，与那些难看的东西混在一起？我们塞壬人来了，神采飞扬，唱着我们悠扬的歌，正适合塞壬人群！

@@U03177@@
（用同样的旋律嘲笑他们。）

@@U03178@@
快点，把它们按倒在地，因为隐藏在那些叶子里的是长长的、带钩的、丑陋的爪子，如果你侧耳倾听它们的声音，它们就会落在你背信弃义的人身上。

@@U03180@@
远离仇恨，远离嫉妒！在最纯洁的圣杯中，我们倾注了所有最明亮的欢乐。最好的水，最好的地球，美丽的形状，欢乐的形状，将成为欢迎你的人。

@@U03182@@
我听到了什么？最新时尚？啊，当然是新颖的东西！声音和弦乐结合在一起唱歌，所有的一切都以押韵方式交织在一起，一个关于另一个。我迷失了，这种颤音。它让我的耳朵发痒，却无法感动我的心。

@@U03184@@
哈！你的心！别自吹自擂了，从你的脸来判断，一个干瘪的皮包更像是它。
